item.title: Jazz in the Plaza — Sun Sep 6, 1:00 PM — Putnam Plaza
item.description:
Every Sunday: Free, live jazz every week performed by some of the best musicians in the SF Bay Area and beyond, right in the heart of downtown Petaluma! Every Sunday from 1 to 3:30, local jazz bassist and music book publisher Chuck Sher presents a rotating ensemble of professional, veteran jazz musicians in Putnam Plaza Park, right next to the Speakeasy. This event started in 2020 and has since become a staple for locals and visitors alike. Stop by and enjoy some of the best jazz the Bay Area has to offer!
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Henry Frank: J-80928: A Human Experience Exhibition — Mon Sep 7, 10:00 AM — San Geronimo Valley Community Center
item.description:
The San Geronimo Valley Community Center is proud to present featured September artist **Henry Frank** in the Del Mue Galleries this September. There will be a reception for the artist as part of the International Day of Peace Festival Finale on **September 20 from 2 – 6 pm**.
**J-80928: A Human Experience Exhibition** explores Henry Frank’s transformative journey through nearly three decades of incarceration in the California Department of Corrections. Through deeply personal artwork, the exhibition reflects on trauma, friendship, identity, hope, and personal growth while inviting viewers to recognize the humanity and capacity for change in people who are incarcerated.

item.title: Rally for Civil Rights — Tue Sep 8, 8:30 AM — San Rafael Civic Center
item.description:
Join us in amplifying the voices of those we’ve lost due to jail and county staffs’ abuse of inmates resulting in death, their deliberate indifference and insufficient staffing and training. After 19 hours in a sobering cell without medical care, Marin County quickly released my sister for an ambulance ride to hospital where she later died. And they’re trying to dodge accountability for her death and hide behind that paper release, claiming she wasn’t in their care when she died. Well I can certainly agree that she wasn’t “in their CARE” at all, as they blatantly ignored her deteriorating medical condition and her screams for help.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Great Company Grand Opening Celebration — Wed Sep 9, 4:00 PM — Great Company
item.description:
The table is set for something new at the Village.
Join us on Wednesday, September 9 as we celebrate the grand opening of Great Company, a locally owned dinner party shop bringing a thoughtful selection of home goods, serve ware and conversation-starting details to Montgomery Village.
Born from the founders of Reed & James Events, Great Company is a natural extension of their love for hosting and bringing people together. The shop was inspired by a simple belief that life’s best moments happen around the table, where good food, thoughtful touches and great company come together. From intimate dinners to lively celebrations, Great Company makes it easier to gather, celebrate and build community.
Come celebrate with complimentary goodies, a special pop-up from L’Occitane and more surprises throughout the day.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Henry Frank: J-80928: A Human Experience Exhibition — Fri Sep 11, 10:00 AM — San Geronimo Valley Community Center
item.description:
The San Geronimo Valley Community Center is proud to present featured September artist **Henry Frank** in the Del Mue Galleries this September. There will be a reception for the artist as part of the International Day of Peace Festival Finale on **September 20 from 2 – 6 pm**.
**J-80928: A Human Experience Exhibition** explores Henry Frank’s transformative journey through nearly three decades of incarceration in the California Department of Corrections. Through deeply personal artwork, the exhibition reflects on trauma, friendship, identity, hope, and personal growth while inviting viewers to recognize the humanity and capacity for change in people who are incarcerated.
